$$AD = 2R\sin(60^\circ - \gamma) = 2R\left(\sin 60^\circ\cos\gamma - \cos 60^\circ\sin\gamma\right).$$
$$= \frac{98\sqrt{3}}{3}\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\frac{71}{98} - \frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{39\sqrt{3}}{98}\right) = \frac{98\sqrt{3}}{3}\cdot\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\frac{71-39}{98}$$
$$= \frac{98\sqrt{3}}{3}\cdot\frac{32\sqrt{3}}{196} = \frac{98\cdot 32\cdot 3}{3\cdot 196} = \frac{32\cdot 98}{196} = 16.$$
